steps.text: Preview before applying. Full API and voice ('generate pro context menus'). Tests, help, Shipped features. Fable for the context-menu@1 schema and the hub source.
New console plugin 'Context menus', integrated with the UI Manager (its menus show there per element/zone).

ONE TRUE SOURCE: every context menu definition is stored on axHub (not local), as context-menu@1 assets, readable and writable by every plugin and app through the hub API. Plugins register the actions/hooks they offer; menus reference them.
The plugin lists every context menu in the app (per zone/element/page, with its parent app, plugin or page), searchable, with preview, edit and Restore per row, snapshots and restore like skins.

AI generation (needs Claude; greyed out with a clear error when the Claude badge isn't green): generate the context menus for the whole app at a chosen level. BEGINNER: a few big, obvious actions. AMATEUR: common actions. PRO: full working set grouped. ADVANCED CODER: meticulous map of every zone with deep actions (tokens, API, inspect, copy ids, run commands). Higher levels map the app more meticulously. Menus are slim by default (no wasted space, rarely used items folded away). The user picks the level, and it can differ per app/page.
